dialogue_entries._note: Deliberately below the sand quest. Vesk is uninterested until you are useful, and a player who finds the bark before meeting him should still get his introduction first.

quests.title: Kiln-Ash
quests.summary: Vesk cannot fire without clean sand, and will not send anyone else for it.

steps.tracker: Gather three measures of white sand from the channel bank.
Take the sand to Vesk at the kiln.

quests.title: A Lens for Reading
quests.summary: Brann's setting plate is weathered past reading. Vesk knows what would fix that.

steps.tracker: Grind a reading lens at Vesk's kiln.

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: Vesk does not look up from the kiln mouth.
"If you're here to watch, stand further back. If you're here to be useful, I'm short of sand."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "White. Off the bank where the water sorts it — the current does the sieving, I don't have to."
"Three measures. Don't scoop the grey, it's got iron in it and it'll spit at me."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "Well?"

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: Vesk takes the sand, weighs it in one hand, and grunts in a way that is apparently approval.
"Right. You've seen the whole of it now — the sand, the heat, the cooling. That's the work."
"Come and grind whatever you like. Blanks, reading glass, the wide sort, the burning sort. You know where the kiln is."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "Brann's been up here twice asking about that plate of his. The one at the gear housing."
"Cut stone, weathered flat. You'd need to bring your eye to within an inch of it, and nobody's eye works at an inch."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "A reading lens. Blank first, then grind it down. Flat on the rim so it sits on the stone without rocking."
"It's not difficult. It's just fussy, and Brann's hands shake now."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "Let's see it, then."

choices.text: I found this in the pool.

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: Vesk turns it against the light, looking for the flaw he expects to find.
"Hm. That'll read stone. Take it to him before he asks me a third time."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: Vesk takes it, turns it over, and goes quiet for slightly too long.
"...That's not mine. That's not anyone's I know of. The grind on that is better than mine and it's been in the water twenty years."
He hands it back, and does not entirely let go of it first.
"Well. It'll read the plate. Whoever made it could grind, I'll say that."

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "You've got that grey on your sleeve. Off the eastern trees, is it?"
He rubs it between finger and thumb, and stops moving.
"That's kiln ash. Not wood ash — kiln. Fired hot, fired long, and gone through twice."
"My kiln was cold on the last Quietday. Cold from the night before, and I can show you the bricks."
"So who's firing?"

nodes.speaker: npc.vesk
lines: "It's at temperature. I'm not talking through the good part."
